description: Update a saved job's status, outcome or details. Use status for where the application is now (interviewing, negotiation for an offer, hired). Use outcome for an applied job that ended without progressing: rejected, no_response (no reply after 45+ days), withdrawn, or didnt_apply; status stays as it is. With didnt_apply, give a reason: job_closed reports the listing as expired, and the rest improve the user's future matches. Add detail for anything worth knowing (what the page said, a hidden requirement). Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

detail.description: Anything worth knowing about the outcome, in a sentence or two. No personal data.

outcome.description: What happened after applying, as reported by the user. "clear" removes a recorded outcome.

reason.description: Why the user didn't apply (only with outcome didnt_apply)

name: update_job_status
title: Update job status
